info.name: TenantTable API
info.description:
TenantTable is a multi-tenant Restaurant POS backend API.

Features: Authentication & Authorization, Tenant Management, Employee Management, Category & Menu Management, Dining Table Management, Order Management, Billing & Payments.

All protected endpoints require a JWT Bearer token. Every request is isolated to the authenticated tenant.

request.description: Creates a new order for a dining table and initializes it with the provided menu items.
Adds a menu item to an existing active order. If the item already exists, its quantity is increased.
Updates the quantity of an existing item in an active order and recalculates the order totals.
Updates the current status of an order (for example: PREPARING, SERVED, COMPLETED, or CANCELLED).
Applies a discount to the order and recalculates the final payable amount.
Retrieves complete details of a specific order, including items, totals, discounts, and current status.
Returns a paginated list of completed and historical orders for the authenticated tenant.
Returns a paginated list of orders that are currently active (not completed or cancelled).
Removes a specific item from an active order and updates the order totals.
Retrieves a paginated list of payments for the current tenant.
Records a payment for an existing order and marks the order as completed.
Retrieves a payment by its unique identifier.
Retrieves the payment associated with a specific order.
Retrieves the receipt details for a paid order.
Generates and returns a printable PDF receipt for a paid order.
